title: Human GBA1 Gene PCR and Sanger Sequencing Protocols
author: nahid tayebi
materials: BigDye™ Terminator v3.1 Ready Reaction Mix
ThermoFisher purification Kit, Cat: 4376486, and the protocol from Applied Biosystems, following the link protocol.

steps.title: Isolate high‑molecular‑weight DNA
steps.instruction: Extract high‑molecular‑weight genomic DNA from patient or control blood samples or cultured cell lines using a suitable DNA isolation method.

steps.title: Amplify GBA1 fragments by PCR
steps.instruction: Set up three PCR reactions to amplify the GBA1 gene (exons 1‑5, 5‑8, and 8‑11) using Takara ExTaq enzyme, buffer, and dNTPs (product # TAK RR001A) and run the thermal cycler with Takara‑recommended cycling conditions.

substeps.instruction: Fragment 1 (exons 1‑5): primers E1F (5’-CCTAAAGTTGTCACCCATAC-3’) and 39R (5’-AGCAGACCTACCCTACAGTTT-3’), annealing at 57 °C, expected product 2,960 bp.
Fragment 2 (exons 5‑8): primers 127F (5’-GACCTCAAATGATATACCTG-3’) and 66R (5’-AGTTTGGGAGCCAGTCATTT-3’), annealing at 60 °C, expected product 3,163 bp.
Fragment 3 (exons 8‑11): primers cor8F (5’-TGTGTGCAAGGTCCAGGATCAG-3’) and 172R (5’-ACCACCTAGAGGGGAAAGTG-3’), annealing at 61 °C, expected product 1,750 bp.

steps.title: Purify PCR products
steps.instruction: Purify each of the three PCR amplicons with the QIAGEN MinElute PCR Purification Kit (Cat #: 28004) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Prepare cycle‑sequencing reactions
steps.instruction: For each purified fragment, combine 80‑150 ng DNA, 1 µL sequencing primer, 2 µL Terminator buffer, 5 µL UltraPure DNase/RNase‑free water, and 1 µL BigDye Terminator (v3.1 or v1.1/v3.1 5X buffer) to a final volume of 10 µL; cap, briefly centrifuge, and run the thermocycler using the BigDye protocol.

substeps.instruction: Add 80‑150 ng of purified PCR DNA to each well.
Add 1 µL of the appropriate sequencing primer.
Prepare a master mix (per reaction): 2 µL Terminator buffer, 5 µL water, 1 µL BigDye Terminator; bring total volume to 10 µL.
Cap wells, spin briefly, and place in the thermocycler.

steps.title: Clean sequencing products with CleanSEQ
steps.instruction: Purify the sequencing reactions using Agencourt CleanSEQ magnetic beads (Beckman Coulter, Cat: A29154) following the bead‑based protocol.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the CleanSEQ beads by shaking until the suspension is homogeneous and no pellet remains.
Add 10 µL CleanSEQ reagent to each 10 µL sequencing reaction (use 10 µL regardless of reaction volume).
Add 85 % ethanol calculated as Volume = 2.077 × (10 µL + sample volume); pipette mix at least seven times until homogeneous.
Place the plate on a magnetic rack (Beckman Coulter Agencourt SPRIPlate 96R) for 3‑5 min until the solution becomes clear and beads collect on the side.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Add 100 µL 85 % ethanol to each well, keep the plate on the magnet, and wait ≥30 s for beads to resettle.
Aspirate and discard the ethanol (first wash).
Repeat the 100 µL 85 % ethanol wash and aspiration a second time (second wash).
Air‑dry the beads for 10 min at room temperature.
Add 40 µL UltraPure water to each well and incubate 2‑5 min at room temperature to elute the purified sequencing product.
Place the plate on the magnet for 3‑5 min until the eluate clears.
Transfer 30 µL of the clear eluate to a new plate for loading on the sequencer.
Seal the plate and store at 4 °C for up to 24 h, or at –20 °C for up to one month if not loaded immediately.
